title: Zill occupational heat-limit oracle vectors (NIOSH/ACGIH/ISO 7243/NWS HI/TB MED 507/OSHA)

units.mW: W, whole-body metabolic rate (NOT W/m2); ACGIH/NIOSH values assume a 70 kg worker
units.wbgtC / *C: degC (WBGT_eff = measured WBGT + clothing adjustment value)
units.workFraction / f: fraction of each hour spent working (0-1)

conventions.limit_comparison: exceedance means WBGT_eff > limit (strict); WBGT_eff == limit is within the limit
conventions.acgih_rounding: nearest 0.5 degC, half-up: floor(2x + 0.5)/2 (no ties occur in the table)
conventions.nws_threshold: regression used when simple formula >= 80 degF (equation-page text rule)
conventions.osha_hi_levels: <91 lower; [91,103) moderate; [103,115] high; >115 very high to extreme (degF)
conventions.nprm_triggers: initial: HI >= 80 degF or WBGT >= RAL(M); high: HI >= 90 degF or WBGT >= REL(M)
